article_content: (CNN) -- U.S. oil and gas production increased during President Barack Obama's administration, though the drivers remain debated. Mitt Romney contended in a 2012 debate that growth occurred 'despite Obama's policies,' asserting all increases came from private lands with reduced federal permitting. U.S. Energy Information Administration data reveals private land natural gas production grew by 16.4 billion cubic feet daily from fiscal 2005-2011 (covering both Bush and Obama presidencies), while federal/Indian land production declined. Federal lands' share of domestic gas output dropped from 35% to 21% over eight years. Oil production patterns vary: Private land output decreased through the 2000s before rising 385,000 barrels daily in 2011. Federal/offshore production increased from 1.6 million to 2 million barrels daily (2008-2010), then dipped to 1.8 million in 2011 following the Deepwater Horizon disaster. Annual federal production averaged 675,000 barrels under Obama versus 609,000 during Bush's last term. Permitting statistics show 5,568 new federal land leases under Obama's first three fiscal years versus 9,661 in Bush's final three - a 42.4% decrease. Drilling permits fell 37.4% (20,479 to 12,821). While substantial, this contradicts Romney's 'halved' claim. The Institute for Energy Research attributes these trends to long-term policy shifts beyond any single administration.

Mitt Romney wuxuu 2012kii doodo ku sheegay in korortu 'ka soo horjeedka siyaasadaha Obama' ay ka dhacday, isagoo sheegay in dhammaan kordhintu ka yimid dhulka madaxbanaan iyadoo ogolaanshaha federaalku yaraadeen. Xogta Ururka Macluumaadka Tamarta Maraykanka (EIA) waxay muujisay in soo-saarka gaaska dhulka madaxbannaan (shakhsi ahaaneed) kor u kacay 16.4 bilyan kubik cagahood maalintii laga bilaabo 2005 ilaa 2011 (oo ku jira xilliyadii Bush iyo Obama), halka soo-saarka dhulka federaalka iyo Hindiya uu si joogto ah u yaraaday. Saamiga dhulka federaalka ee soo-saarka gaaska Maraykanka wuxuu ka soo degay 35% ilaa 21% siddeed sanno. Habka soo-saarka saliiddu wuxuu kala duwan yahay: Dhulka madaxbannaan waxaa hoos u dhacay soo-saarka 2000kii, ka dibna kor u kacay 385,000 barel maalintii sanadkii 2011. Dhulka federaalka iyo badda, soo-saarku wuxuu kacay 1.6 milyan ilaa 2 milyan barel maalintii (2008-2010), ka dibna uu hoos ugu dhacay 1.8 milyan sanadkii 2011 ka dib dhaawaca Deepwater Horizon. Celcelis ahaan, sanadkii Obama waxaa lagu soo saaray 675,000 barel dhulka federaalka, ka dib 609,000 sanadkii ugu dambeeyay Bush. Xogta ogolaanshaha waxay tusaale u tahay in qirahsyada cusub ee dhulka federaalku yaraadeen 42.4% (5,568 vs 9,661) saddexda sanno ee ugu dambeeyay Bush. Ogolaanshaha qodista waxaa hoos u dhacay 37.4%. Inkastoo tani tahay hoos u dhac weyn, kuma dhammaystiran sheegashadii Romney ee 'nus u dhimatay'. Ururka Cilmi-baarista Tamarta (IER) wuxuu tilmaamay in arrintan ay ka timaaddo isbeddelada siyaasadeed ee muddada dheer, aan ku koobnayn siyaasadaha Obama.

article_content: BBC Arabic correspondent Feras Khatib was interrupted during a live broadcast from Ashkelon, Israel, when an individual shoved him off-camera. Colleagues immediately restrained the individual while Khatib resumed reporting within seconds. The incident occurred amid heightened tensions in the Israel-Gaza conflict, which has resulted in 609 Palestinian fatalities (per Gaza Health Ministry) and 29 Israeli deaths (27 soldiers, 2 civilians) according to official reports. United Nations estimates suggest 75% of Palestinian casualties were civilians. Separately, Al Jazeera journalist Wael Al-Dahdouh paused mid-report when overcome with emotion while discussing conflict victims. A BBC spokesperson confirmed Khatib, an Arab-Israeli citizen and former Sky News Arabia journalist, sustained no injuries and continued reporting.

article_content: A farmer has developed purple, green, and orange cauliflower varieties to encourage healthier diets through visually appealing vegetables. Andrew Burgess, a 48-year-old agricultural director at Produce World, created these 'rainbow' cauliflowers by cross-breeding ancient organic varieties on his Peterborough trial farm. The hybrids—Grafitti (purple, high in antioxidants), Ortoli (orange, rich in carotene), and Vitaverde (green, vitamin C and fibre)—were hand-pollinated and refined over five years. Burgess aims to commercialize the nutty-flavored orange variety, potentially selling mixed-color florets in supermarkets. The vegetables, part of the Brassica oleracea family, align with Burgess' goal to make nutritious food more engaging. His family business, producing 500,000 tonnes of vegetables annually with 1,000 employees, traces its roots to 1898.
